name: activin A receptor type 1B

function.text: ACVR1B encodes activin receptor type-1B. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine/threonine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Sequence mutations in ACVR1B have been reported in pituitary tumors; their presence alone does not establish a uniform functional or clinical effect.
